description: Deterministic seeded evaluator challenge manifest. Expected outcomes are benchmark oracle labels, not live recovery observations.

cases.name: clean_complete_recovery
cases.description: Complete authenticated evidence and closed scope; recovery invariants pass.

cases.name: safe_historical_signature
cases.description: Capture interval ends before effective revocation and trust checkpoint is valid.

cases.name: unrelated_claim_survives_revocation
cases.description: Revocation affects another claim only; this claim has no dependency path to it.

cases.name: missing_schema_history
cases.description: Rows reconcile but required DDL/schema-history surface is absent.

cases.name: forged_capture_receipt
cases.description: Receipt signature fails under independently pinned trust root.

cases.name: replayed_receipt_nonce
cases.description: Previously consumed one-use nonce is replayed.

cases.name: untrusted_root_substitution
cases.description: Trust snapshot is not authenticated to configured root.

cases.name: stale_revocation_checkpoint
cases.description: Freshness requirement cannot be established.

cases.name: revocation_before_capture
cases.description: Effective revocation precedes the entire capture interval.

cases.name: revocation_overlaps_capture_interval
cases.description: Capture uncertainty interval overlaps effective revocation.

cases.name: clock_skew_unbounded
cases.description: No defensible temporal ordering can be established.

cases.name: inventory_from_same_compromised_plane
cases.description: Nominally separate inventories share a single compromised authority.

cases.name: unsupported_required_capability
cases.description: Mandatory state surface has no qualified capture capability.

cases.name: false_complete_inventory
cases.description: Independent source inventory contains a required member absent from capture scope.

cases.name: unrelated_claim_overinvalidated
cases.description: Mutation damages unrelated claim; exact affected set is known.

cases.name: dependent_claim_not_invalidated
cases.description: Revoked prerequisite remains in downstream claim dependency closure.

cases.name: expired_claim_admitted
cases.description: Claim lease expired before relying-party admission.

cases.name: canonicalization_key_order_mutation
cases.description: Canonical bytes diverge from golden JCS vector.

cases.name: duplicate_json_member
cases.description: Parser silently collapses duplicate object member names.

cases.name: domain_separation_removed
cases.description: Claim digest no longer uses required domain separation.

cases.name: admission_target_substitution
cases.description: Token for one recovery target is presented for another.

cases.name: admission_nonce_race
cases.description: Two concurrent mutations attempt to consume the same nonce.

cases.name: all_indeterminate_evaluator
cases.description: Evaluator evades false qualifications but fails required positive-control decision coverage.

cases.name: positive_control_false_block
cases.description: Known-safe control is incorrectly blocked.

cases.name: conflicting_source_witnesses
cases.description: Independent witnesses disagree and conflict policy is unresolved.

cases.name: partial_kafka_partition_coverage
cases.description: At least one required partition lacks a qualified terminal boundary.

cases.name: application_invariant_failure
cases.description: Storage and schema checks pass but required application invariant fails.
